scope: same-boot selection of an ephemeral AirDrop AWDL peer

software.selectionSignal: parsed _airdrop._tcp service response in a live MIF
software.selectionLifetime: one bounded boot; ephemeral MAC retained only in RAM

result.confirmed: A bounded lab image can select a protocol-confirmed ephemeral AirDrop receiver from its live MIF and exercise that exact peer without compiling its MAC into firmware. The one-session lock prevents later unrelated peers from changing the target. The distance-zero qualifier remains passive when no eligible receiver is present, and the admission gate suppresses mDNS when the selected peer gives no directed response.
result.notConfirmed: The distance-one AirDrop receiver did not return a directed Neighbor Advertisement or Echo Reply, so no live endpoint or TCP connection was retained.
result.nextFocus: Determine the current peer-admission state or MIF content required by distance-one receivers, while retaining the same-boot selector so the next eligible session can reach the implemented DNS-SD resolver without a rebuild race.
